note: SIC files AbbVie with the other drug makers (2834); the GICS-style label puts it in Biotechnology. Same sector and same Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology & Life Sciences group, so AbbVie counts as one of the major pharmaceutical companies alongside JNJ, LLY, MRK and PFE.
Both class Amazon as a retailer. AWS (cloud) is a large share of its profit but does not change either classification.

Asset manager, which GICS also places in Capital Markets. EDGAR now names this CIK BlackRock Finance, Inc. after BlackRock's 2024 holding-company reorganisation; the Corpus Filing (FY2023) predates it and is BlackRock Inc's.

SIC classes Berkshire by its insurance operations; the GICS-style label treats it as a multi-sector holding company (railroad, utilities, manufacturing and insurance). Same sector, different industry.

SIC has a single Retail division and no staples/discretionary split. The GICS-style label puts general merchandise retailers that mainly sell food and household goods (Costco, Target, Walmart) in Consumer Staples, apart from Amazon and Home Depot in Consumer Discretionary.
SIC files integrated oil majors under refining (a manufacturing code); both place Chevron in oil and gas.
SIC reflects Disney's theme parks (amusement and recreation, a consumer services code); the GICS-style label classes it by its media and streaming business as Entertainment in Communication Services.

The only GE Filing is GE Capital's (General Electric Capital Corporation) FY2014 10-K, filed under GE Capital's CIK, so it is classed by what it reports on: a lender and lessor. General Electric Company itself (today GE Aerospace) would be Industrials, Aerospace & Defense. Disputable; raised with the Client.

SIC classes Alphabet as a computer services company; the GICS-style label classes it by its advertising-funded search and YouTube business as Interactive Media & Services (moved from Information Technology to Communication Services in 2018).
SIC still reflects IBM's hardware history; the GICS-style label classes it by today's software and consulting business as IT Services. Same sector, different industry.
Also has a large MedTech business; both classifications still class it as a drug maker.
SIC classes payment networks as business services; the GICS-style label puts them in Financials (Transaction & Payment Processing Services), where GICS moved them from Information Technology in 2023.
SIC classes Meta as a computer services company; the GICS-style label classes it by its advertising-funded social media business as Interactive Media & Services in Communication Services.
SIC still files Netflix under video tape rental, from its DVD-by-mail origins; the GICS-style label classes the streaming business as Entertainment in Communication Services.
Also a large snack-food maker (Frito-Lay); both classifications class it as a beverage company.
